honesty.banner: Sample / demo dataset — not a live intelligence feed. These briefs are illustrative and labeled. They are not current-event reports.

articles.headline: Canal authority reduces daily transit slots after prolonged drought
articles.factualSummary: In this sample scenario, a canal operator publishes a status notice reducing daily vessel transit slots after months of below-normal rainfall. The notice cites lower water levels and asks carriers to expect longer waits.

articles.headline: Government announces higher tariffs on selected steel imports
articles.factualSummary: In this sample scenario, a trade authority publishes a notice raising tariff rates on selected steel product lines. The notice lists covered product codes and an effective date.

articles.headline: Carriers divert sailings away from a contested maritime corridor
articles.factualSummary: In this sample scenario, a maritime advisory notes that several carriers are diverting sailings away from a contested corridor after security incidents. Public notices describe longer alternate routes and schedule uncertainty.

articles.headline: Ransomware disrupts a major fuel pipeline operator’s billing systems
articles.factualSummary: In this sample scenario based on a well-known historical pattern, a pipeline operator reports a ransomware incident affecting business systems and temporarily pauses some operations. Public advisories describe precautionary shutdowns.

articles.headline: Labor stoppage slows cargo handling at a major coastal port complex
articles.factualSummary: In this sample scenario, a port authority reports slowed or paused cargo handling during a labor stoppage at a major complex. Public updates describe vessel queues and limited operations.
